data.title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
data.description: Présentation du poste : Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients. Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge. Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents. Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons. Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect. Activités et responsabilités : Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client. Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner. Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact. Vos responsabilités : Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux. Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride. Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées. Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre. Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris. Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery. Tenir la ligne pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change. Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO. Les indispensables : Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery. Un plus, pas un prérequis : Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche. Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès. Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes. Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA. Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients. Une certification d’architecture cloud. Une pratique régulière des coding agents. Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux. Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en. Process de recrutement : HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist. Architecture Case (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission. US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client. Rémunération : Package : 75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité. Présentation de l’entreprise Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients. Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
data.description: Mission Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer. Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production. Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées. Vos responsabilités : Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud. Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming. Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps. Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité. Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence. Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection. Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent. Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts. Profil recherché Les indispensables : Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code. Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique. Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien. Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents. Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent. Un plus, pas un prérequis : Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake. Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation. Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage. FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts. Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails. Une certification cloud. Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client. Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression. Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables. Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire. Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais. Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production). Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect. Processus de recrutement Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance). Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions. Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée. Rémunération : 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

data.title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
data.description: Mission De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances. Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer. Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez. Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien. Vos responsabilités : Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes. Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations. Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier. Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade. Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas. Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection. Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés. Profil recherché Les indispensables : Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué. Votre code est testé et maintenable. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique. Un plus, pas un prérequis : Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage. Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science. Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP. Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix. Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts. Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie. Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression. Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables. Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire. Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais. Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA). Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions. data.title: CDI - Senior AI Builder - Paris
data.description: L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle. Et tout commence par vous. Mission En tant que Senior AI Builder, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients. **Vous transmettez et construisez : vous pilotez des initiatives de montée en compétences, concevez avec les métiers des agents et solutions IA qui répondent à leurs besoins, et accompagnez leur adoption. Vous coachez les consultants juniors et êtes responsable de la qualité et des résultats de vos travaux. Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. **Vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide** : vous concevez et animez des expériences d’apprentissage qui donnent envie de passer à l’action, construisez des agents et des solutions fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et les faites évoluer au contact de leurs utilisateurs pour ancrer de nouveaux usages. Au plus près des métiers, vous identifiez les opportunités de repenser les tâches, faire évoluer les rôles et responsabilités, et réinventer les façons de travailler avec l’IA. Vous faites le lien entre les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) et les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), aux côtés de nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre réussite se mesure à l’adoption réelle des solutions, à l’autonomie des équipes et aux changements concrets dans leur quotidien. Activités & Responsabilités I. Proposer la solution cible, le rôle de l’humain et de l’agent, les contrôles nécessaires et les critères d’acceptation. Concevoir le séquencement d’un module ou d’un parcours, avec cas d’usage, temps de pratique et modalités d’évaluation. II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions Créer des ateliers et playbooks contextualisés, prototyper des assistants ou agents simples en amont et en direct avec les participants, à l'aide de plateformes approuvées et de patterns réutilisables.Définir et exécuter jeux d'essai, tests utilisateurs et critères qualité; documenter les limites et faire valider les points sensibles.Animer de manière autonome, adapter la séance au niveau du public et coacher un Junior sur ses premières animations.Traduire une question business en KPIs, en définitions et en dashboards complets livrés en autonomie, et transformer les analyses en storyline avec un « so what » clair. III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté Organiser office hours, challenges d'application et train-the-trainer, outiller des champions et des managers de proximité. Accompagner la mise en usage, former les référents makers et préparer les supports de transfert. Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pendant le périmètre convenu et proposer des améliorations priorisées. IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change Suivre l'adoption et la valeur du use case, les compétences acquises, la capacité à répliquer et les premiers usages; proposer des ajustements concrets pour améliorer l'activation. Contribuer à l’analyse des freins et au plan de change du programme, sous la responsabilité du chef de mission. Identifier les dépendances SI, les risques sécurité et le besoin d'escalade vers la DSI ou AI Engineering. Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence. data.company_name: Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering - BIIE
data.title: Communications Officer
data.description: About the BIIE The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region. Position Overview We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences. Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities. This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events. Key Responsibilities Content Creation Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials. Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content. Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics. Website & Social Media Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date. Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling. Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Internal Communications Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged. Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials. Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity. Stakeholder Engagement & Events Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring. Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM. Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities. Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities. Communications Strategy & General Support Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities. Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials. Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute. Required Qualifications Essential University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field. At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role. Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German. Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels. Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences. Strong organisational and project management skills. Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts. A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation. Preferred Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE. Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics. Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva. Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content. Additional languages apart from English and German. Experience working in an international and multicultural environment. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.description: The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results. Key Responsibilities Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities Qualifications Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU) Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment What We Bring The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality. Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others. At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients. data.title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
data.description: Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with: Linux running on embedded hardware C/C++, Python & Bash codebases Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion Responsibilities Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products. Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases. Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market. Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues. Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base. Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings. Qualifications and Skills B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields. 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting. Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization. Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking. Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot. Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments. Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender). Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc. Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues. Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification. Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms. Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus. Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers. Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages. Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages. Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem. Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI. Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board. A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives. EU Citizenship required. Benefits Flexible working hours Stock Options Generous holiday allowance Company pension plan Car parking Enhanced maternity & paternity leave Mental health and wellbeing support Learning and development opportunities About Auterion We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters. data.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
data.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. data.title: Head of Customer Success
data.description: About Rivia Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments. Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost. We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup. About the role We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth. You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset. Ownership and Commercial Collaboration Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities. Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes. What excites you Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth. Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development. Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes. Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts. Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales. Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do. What You’ll Do Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring. Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization. Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution. Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales. Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers. Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements. Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities. Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales. Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy. What excites us: Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers. A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field. Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers. Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration. Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates. Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders. A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment. What Makes You Stand Out Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company. Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows. Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts. A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes. Our Values At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive. Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve. Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious. Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems. Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another. Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results. data.title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
data.description: Who is Artefact? Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm that transforms organizations through data and AI. With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. From our Lausanne and Zurich offices, we help leading Swiss and international companies turn data and AI into measurable results, working with the leading data platforms, including Databricks. Main Responsibilities You will design and deliver the data platforms our clients run their business and their AI on, combining hands-on engineering with client advisory. Build modern data platforms: End-to-end lakehouse architectures, mainly on Databricks, built for reliability, observability, and cost. Engineer pipelines: Batch and streaming pipelines with Python, Spark, and SQL, with data quality built in. Migrate and modernize: Move legacy warehouses and ETL to the cloud, from assessment to cut-over. Make data ready for AI: Governed data products and semantic layers that analytics and AI agents can rely on. Run it properly: Data governance, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cost control. Advise and support: Translate business needs into roadmaps, coach junior engineers, and support proposals. Candidate Profile Engineer first, consultant second, with a track record of shipping to production. 5+ years in data engineering, including hands-on Databricks experience in production. Expert Python and SQL, with strong Spark and data modeling skills. Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification, or a commitment to obtain it within 6 months (we support you). Experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus DataOps (Git, CI/CD, Terraform, testing). Strong consulting skills: requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder management. Fluent English plus French or German (both is a plus); eligible to work in Switzerland. Nice to have: Experience with other data platforms (Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery), dbt, MLOps, and industry experience (consumer goods, pharma, logistics, insurance, manufacturing). Why Join Us Strategy with a Data Edge: Build the platforms behind boardroom priorities. Swiss Impact: High visibility from day one on flagship programs, working directly with senior leadership. Strong Tech Ecosystem: Certified peers across Artefact and close partnerships with leading data and cloud platforms. Growth and Culture: Certifications, training, international missions, and a team of doers who move fast and support each other. If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Tell us about your passion, curiosity, and impact. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.title: Backend Engineer - Integration Platform
data.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics , or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back. We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code. What you'll do Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements. Build great software: design and build clean, maintainable services in Go, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews. Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow. Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices. Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP. What you bring 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation Nice to have Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code. Experience with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Google Cloud Monitoring. German. What you'll get Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers. Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code. A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales. Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Regular team events. Practical information Location: Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week. Employment: full-time, permanent. Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

data.title: Head of AI
data.description: About Poesis Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction. You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning. You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications. You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data. You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas. Nice to Have Experience with frontier tabular ML methods. Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets. Location Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available. Compensation Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits). data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
data.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved. Experience working in a regulated environment. Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work. A systematic, process-oriented way of working. The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems. A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements. The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed. Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices. Nice to have: Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working. Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required. Experience with MDSAP How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including pension plan 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position Hybrid work model Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away. Training budget Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
data.description: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands. Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel. We’re looking for: You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one. Our P&C team Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time. What you will be doing: Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in: Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer. Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike. Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way. Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail. Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them. Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area. Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board. Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox. Skills and mindset: (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa). Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact. Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment. Ability to work well in a dynamic environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Fluent in English. Our offer A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s). A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office. 2 days of paid leave per month. We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection. 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship. A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers. Joining monthly borrels and other social events. The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career. Curious to apply? Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact . Preferred start date 18 January. We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills. If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring. In the meantime… If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide? Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com . data.title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
data.description: Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen. Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten. Jouw afstudeeropdracht Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd? Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid. Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen. Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework . Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten. Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je onderzoekt de markt en concurrenten en verdiept je in de financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken die bij klanten spelen. Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid. Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren. Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren. Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen.
