data.title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description: Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges? Join the Customer Champions team and create a world-class app in which all the value of the Momo platform comes together. Help us create reusable, and above all, user-friendly components and interactions that make caregivers love the app. Who is Momo? Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents. The most valuable aspects of the role 🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks . All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need. ⚓ Work together with many teams , such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software. 💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals . 📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft. 🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions. Your key responsibilities As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both! Your key responsibilities include: Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture. Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. . Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD. Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap. Who are you? You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript , backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments. You validate your features with automated tests , ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests. You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL. A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward. Y ou’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft. Why join Momo Medical? Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day. Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year to pick your own holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!). Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice. Pension plan and travel reimbursement Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles. Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events. Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan Good to know Tech at Momo At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS. What are the next steps? First, we’ll review your CV and motivation to get a sense of how you are and to envision how you might fit within our team. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

data.title: Senior China Research Analyst
data.description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. Your mission at Datenna: Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. What makes you a great candidate: Core requirements Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. Technical skills Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. Nice to have Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. What You’ll Do The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. The role reports to the Head of Quality, QED, with a dotted line to local managing director, and is based in the Netherlands. If the entity becomes the marketing authorisation holder for infigratinib, the role also covers the related MAH quality duties. The role holds an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board and is independent of commercial operations and of manufacturing/supply with EU-GDP guidelines, relevant EU directives (including the Falsified Medicines Directive), Dutch Medicines Act, and public service requirements. This role acts as a QA liaison of BridgeBio's contract service providers (CSPs), providing oversight of lot release activities. This role includes reviewing and approving batch records, certificates of analysis, and compliance documents, providing quality review of deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to assigned CSPs, collaborating closely with CSPs and internal teams such as quality control, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, and supply chain. The role builds and leads a small quality team (deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, QA operations/GDP), owns the quality management system across the Skeletal Dysplasia assets, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and potentially subsequent MIA readiness, if needed in the future.
